events.name: Art of Adventure at Sand Hollow
events.place: Sand Hollow State Park, 3351 Sand Hollow Rd
events.description: A mid-morning nature journaling outing with a park ranger. Journals and drawing materials are provided.

events.name: Movie Meetup at Sand Hollow
events.place: Sand Hollow State Park, 3351 Sand Hollow Rd
events.description: An outdoor movie night at Sand Hollow. Bring blankets and chairs; food vendors will be there. Weather dependent.

events.place: Sand Hollow State Park, 3351 Sand Hollow Rd
events.description: A ranger chat about the full moon during a stroll along the Sand Hollow beach.

events.description: Farm animals, play areas and seasonal attractions at The Farm in Hurricane before it switches to Christmas on The Farm.
